name: shader-lens-blur
title: Shader Lens Blur
description: A WebGL shader that draws a large rounded triangle filled with drifting pastel colour, blurring and inverting near the pointer and following touch.
use: A hero or feature panel needs a single bold shape with an interactive, tactile surface.
avoid: It is a fixed 400px-tall WebGL canvas and needs three and jotai, with no reduced-motion path.
a11y: The canvas has no accessible name or fallback text, and the interaction is pointer-only with no reduced-motion branch. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A big triangle with gently rounded corners glows in a mint-to-blue-to-pink gradient on a black panel. Its edges are soft, and small grey instructions sit at the bottom left.
behaves: The four-colour gradient drifts continuously; moving the pointer across the shape blurs and colour-inverts the area around it, and dragging on touch does the same.
customise: All options live in an external jotai config atom (variation, four colours, hover, size); the component itself takes no props.
weight: heavy: A three.js WebGL scene renders the shader every animation frame.
demo: Caption Inverted mouse interaction using mouse or touch at the bottom left.
issues: No reduced-motion handling; the shader runs every frame regardless.
Interaction is pointer and touch only, so keyboard users cannot affect it.
The canvas gives screen readers nothing to describe.
polishWhy: Soft gradient and a convincing lens blur; limited to one shape and missing a11y.
